scope.task_name: 感知任务驱动的单机单目标轨迹优化方法研究

research_questions.question: Can visual, temporal and low-frequency semantic evidence form a current designated-target state with explicit uncertainty and rejection?
Under shared detector, candidate, constraint and execution budgets, does visibility and identity state improve effective observation and reacquisition?
What path, smoothness, compute, waiting and API costs accompany the improvement, and how does it fail under occlusion, distractors and delay?

perception_factors.yolo_current_evidence: Controlled balloon training and held-out development testing recorded; current frozen specialist checkpoint, formal trajectory detector factor pending
perception_factors.vlx_cloud_transport_currently_declared: image_plus_text; verify actual client and runtime receipts

planned_baselines.name: fixed_follow
planned_baselines.definition: Fixed observation point or offset derived from initial observed estimate; no quality-driven re-ranking; shared safe execution; no target oracle

planned_baselines.name: distance_planning
planned_baselines.definition: Fresh common estimates, shared candidates and constraints, common distance and movement costs; visibility and identity-action factors disabled

planned_baselines.name: visibility_planning
planned_baselines.definition: B1 plus declared visibility and centering factors; semantic identity evidence does not alter trajectory or recovery action

planned_baselines.name: identity_verification_trajectory_loop
planned_baselines.definition: B2 plus temporal identity evidence, finite low-frequency VLX confirmation and identity-triggered hold or re-observation; shared safe executor

denominator_rules.identity_primary: all predeclared evaluation ticks in task tracking window; no output or wrong association counts failure
denominator_rules.truth_missing: report scoring coverage and missing reason; never silently manufacture a correct label
denominator_rules.task_success: all confirmed mission-started rounds; timeout, no feasible plan, no reacquisition, protection and interrupted outcomes remain in ledger
denominator_rules.pre_mission_flight_attempts: retain arm or flight failures separately even if mission has not started
denominator_rules.unknown_start_or_terminal: retain as explicit unknown; never silently exclude
denominator_rules.reacquisition_no_recovery: report no-recovery fraction and window censoring rather than only successful durations
denominator_rules.independent_unit: independently reset round or predeclared scene block; shared-session methods retain pairing

acceptance_map.name: observation_command_media_initial_terminal_development
acceptance_map.scope_limit: six paired UE sessions twelve fixed-height development flights; not formal identity efficacy

acceptance_map.name: measured_execution_allowance
acceptance_map.scope_limit: two independent flights sixteen nested 0.03/0.06 m/s XY pulses; h=1.0 candidate; higher amplitude Z attitude unverified

acceptance_map.name: pose_3D_and_real_image_projection
acceptance_map.required: pure contract plus saved-media replay plus actual image anchors and declared motion conditions

acceptance_map.name: YOLO_candidate_independent_evaluation
acceptance_map.scope_limit: Same map/mesh/red material; 2 held-out UE sessions, 48 images; no formal trajectory efficacy

acceptance_map.name: VLX_finite_async_identity_role
acceptance_map.required: bindings rejection revalidation and actual response ledger
acceptance_map.scope_limit: Saved-frame binding and attribute-cued micro-XY recovery verified; full-cycle .4s timing still pending; no instance guarantee

acceptance_map.name: instance_visibility_truth_and_tick_scoring
acceptance_map.required: validated independent truth and fixed all-tick denominators
acceptance_map.scope_limit: Latest 40/41 slots; point labels, late/unknown and actual gate/clear times kept separately; formal fixed-tick identity coverage pending

acceptance_map.name: four_baselines_and_factor_ablation
acceptance_map.required: four genuinely runnable methods with audited differences; detector and semantic factors isolated

acceptance_map.name: formal_preregistration
acceptance_map.required: new frozen protocol after complete pilots; no null thresholds or trial counts

acceptance_map.name: formal_independent_rounds_all_attempts
acceptance_map.required: frozen balanced paired execution and all-started outcome closure

acceptance_map.name: results_figures_negative_findings_reproduction
acceptance_map.required: independent analysis all-round data figure points and bounded claims

completion_rule: All A1-A10 close for the same final method version and declared scope; answer RQ1-RQ3 from real data without requiring every outcome to favor the proposed method
honesty_limits: no detector score interpreted as identity probability without calibration
no saved-media replay counted as new flight
no sampled no-exceedance claimed as continuous safety proof
no age proxy claimed as exact exposure-to-actuation latency
no command acceleration proxy claimed as actual energy
no current formal method efficacy or thesis readiness claim
ai_assistance: AI-assisted outline and experiment-evidence mapping. No new efficacy data or unverified literature created; university and advisor retain thesis judgment.
